title: Editor
author: @lunokjod
opens: txt md lua json csv ini cfg log
description: A graphical text editor on the glass, with the menu bar of the system: File opens, saves, saves as and closes a page, and View turns it read-only and turns word wrap on and off, the two of them with a tick in the menu. A long file carries a scroll bar on the right of the box, and the gesture that moves it is the app’s to register.
